name: OffWorld Gym
summary: 用于真实机器人强化学习的开放物理环境与基准，通过统一接口提供传感器观测、动作、奖励和真实交互回合。
summaryEn: An open physical robotics environment and benchmark for real-world reinforcement learning with sensor observations, actions, rewards, and interaction episodes.
scale: Physical robot benchmark with repeatable real-world interaction tasks
scaleZh: 包含可重复真实交互任务的物理机器人基准
license: Open-source repository; hardware and dataset conditions may differ
licenseZh: 代码仓库开放；硬件和数据使用条件可能不同
verdict: 真实机器人强化学习环境
wmNote: 真实观测、动作和奖励回合适合研究在线世界模型与控制，但它是环境接口而非固定大规模语料。
wmNoteEn: Real observations, actions, and rewards support online world modeling and control, but this is an environment interface rather than a fixed large corpus.

evidence.sourceTitle: [1910.08639] OffWorld Gym: open-access physical robotics environment for real-world reinforcement learning benchmark and research
evidence.statement: Real robots expose remotely accessible RL interaction environments; service availability is separate from paper-level relevance evidence.
